name: BACH_0180_FSIM_jpeg3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (80%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged simulated frozen section (severity-3 JPEG) cannot exclude Invasive (16%) [F1]; margin call deferred [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 80%, Invasive 16%, Normal 2%, Benign 2% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Favors InSitu; small test set |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage, n=132) | Cannot exclude invasive carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 31% reliability, 94% OOD [F6] (error AUROC 70%) | Suspect input; JPEG degraded |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 20% match (1/5 InSitu, 4/5 Invasive) [F5] | Reference neighbors favor Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · Strongest score (+0.53) pushing toward invasive carcinoma [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · High lymphocyte score (+0.92); descriptive context only [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low duct confinement (-0.18; +0.30 contribution) pushes toward invasive [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 5, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Benign stroma (+1.02; -0.29 contribution) pushes away from invasive · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 3, 4) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasive (+0.26); failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops P(invasive) above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions (2, 3, 4, 10, 11) harbor true stromal invasion, matching 4/5 nearest reference cases.
- Simulated frozen-section and severity-3 JPEG artifacts distort morphology, driving model disagreement and unreliable margin probabilities.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 4, 10**: Inspect highest-risk areas for stromal invasion versus tangential sectioning or artifact.
2. **Region 11**: Check whether atypical epithelium breaches basement membrane or stays duct-confined.
3. **Regions 0, 2, 4**: Assess pleomorphism and lymphocytes (contrasting invasive neighbor BACH_0278); review drafted recut and deeper levels.
